newsitem.title: USA: NOTICE OF SALE - Orlando Utilities Commission.
newsitem.headline: NOTICE OF SALE - Orlando Utilities Commission.

text.p: SUMMARY NOTICE OF SALE
Orlando Utilities Commission
Water and Electric Revenue Bonds Water and Electric
Revenue Bonds
Series 1996A (Multi-Modal) Series 1996B
Mandatory Tender Date: October 1, 2001 Due: October 1, 2011
(Due:October 1, 2023)
Separate sealed bids for each series of the above

captioned Bonds (the Bonds'') to be dated December 1, 1996 will be received at the Commission Room, Second Floor of the Orlando Utilities Commission for the above-captioned bonds at the address given below up to
November 19, 1996
before 10:00 a.m., sharp, or such postponed date and time as will be communicated through MUNIFACTS NEWS SERVICE not less than 24 hours prior to the time bids are to be opened.

All bids upon opening are required to be held firm for one hour. The Series 1996A Bonds are multi-modal bonds in the amount of $60,000,000, have an initial Mandatory Purchase Date of October 1, 2011 and the initial reoffering shall be at par. The Series 1996B Bonds in the amount of $39,995,000 mature October 1, 2011, and are fixed rate bonds.

Initially, while in the Term Rate Mode, interest on the Series 1996A Bonds will by payable April 1, 1997 and semi- annually thereafter on October 1 and April 1 in each year prior to the initial Mandatory Purchase Date. The Series 1996A Bonds are not subject to an interest rate mode adjustment prior to their initial Mandatory Purchase Date.
The several Interest Rate Modes available for the Series 1996A Bonds to the Commission are described in the
Preliminary Official Statement of the Commission date of even date herewith. The Series 1996B Bonds shall have interest payable semi-annually on each April 1 and October 1 commencing April 1, 1997.

The Series 1996A Bonds will not be subject to optional redemption while in the initial Term Rate Mode prior to the initial Mandatory Purchase Date The Series 1996B Bonds shall be subject to optional redemption, unless such redemption features are amended as hereinafter set forth, prior to their maturity at the option of the Commission, in whole or in part, at any time on and after October 1, 2006 from any legally available monies at par without premium. The Series 1996BBonds shall not be subject to optional redemption prior to October 1, 2006.

The Commission reserves the right to alter or amend the redemption terms for the Series 1996B Bonds by announcing such change by MUNIFACTS NEWS SERVICE not later than 10:00 a.m., Orlando, Florida time, on November 18, 1996.

The Bonds will be offered in fully registered book-entry form. The Bonds will be issued subject to the approving legal opinion of co-bond counsel, Bryant, Miller and Olive, P.A. and Marchena and Graham, P.A.
Copies of the Preliminary Official Statement, the Offi
Notice of Sale and the Official Bid Form may be obtained from the Issuer's Financial Advisor, First Southwest
Company, 651 Bryn Mawr Street, Orlando, Florida 32804, Attention:James Lentz, (407) 426-9611.
